abilities.name: Ominous Fog
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while they are wholly within 9" of the **Treelord** in this Regiment of Renown.

abilities.name: Endless Wandering
abilities.effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to use this ability.
